name: Freedom Solar Power
tierNote: About $2.85–$3.20 per watt cash, as reported by a competing installer
usp: The largest Texas-only installer, founded in Austin and certified for Tesla Powerwall.
about: Freedom Solar started in Austin in 2007 and grew into the biggest installer based in Texas. It now also sells generators and heating and cooling under the Freedom Power name, and handles large commercial projects.

name: Longhorn Solar
usp: Family-owned, with all work done in-house by NABCEP-certified employees.
about: Longhorn Solar has installed solar and storage in Texas since 2009 from its base in Pflugerville. It backs systems with a 25-year equipment warranty and a 25-year workmanship warranty.
address: 1421 Wells Branch Pkwy, Ste 110, Pflugerville, TX 78660

name: Lighthouse Solar
usp: A 25-year workmanship guarantee plus a 10-year promise that output reaches 90% of the forecast.
about: Lighthouse Solar has served the Austin area from South 7th Street since 2007. Beyond rooftop systems it builds solar carports and installs batteries and EV chargers.

name: NATiVE Solar
usp: Solar-plus-battery specialists who also take over systems another installer abandoned.
about: NATiVE Solar works from Dripping Springs, just west of Austin, on homes and businesses across Texas. Repair and long-term maintenance are a core part of its work, with a 10-year workmanship warranty.
address: 3998 US-290, Ste D, Dripping Springs, TX 78620

name: 512 Solar
tierNote: The company describes its prices as competitive; no per-watt figure is published
usp: EcoWatch's best local installer for Austin, with a service arm for existing systems.
about: 512 Solar is a small Austin firm founded in 2014. Alongside new installations it troubleshoots, repairs, removes and reinstalls existing arrays, and fits home EV chargers.
address: 1250 S Capital of Texas Hwy, Bldg 3, Ste 400, Austin, TX 78746

name: ATX Solar
usp: Advertises a record of zero paid change orders and a 30-year workmanship warranty.
about: ATX Solar is a locally owned installer in downtown Austin. It focuses on residential solar and battery storage and promotes clear, fixed pricing.

name: Alba Energy
usp: Austin-based with Spanish-language service and offices in five other Texas cities.
about: Alba Energy has designed and installed residential and commercial systems since 2013. It offers a 10-year workmanship warranty on top of manufacturer coverage.
address: 1601 Rio Grande St, Ste 300, Austin, TX 78701

name: Greenbelt Solar
tierNote: The company describes its prices as fair; purchase is upfront only
usp: Woman-owned, with the same people designing, installing and maintaining systems since 2009.
about: Greenbelt Solar is a South Austin contractor serving homes, businesses and public buildings across Central Texas. It works in English and Spanish and does not offer financing.

name: HESOLAR
usp: Run by twin brothers, both master electricians, who work directly with every customer.
about: HESOLAR is an electrical contractor in Buda that serves only the Greater Austin area. All design, installation and service is done in-house with a 25-year workmanship warranty; it does not offer its own financing.

name: Texas Solar Power Company
usp: One of the longest-running solar contractors in Texas, in business since the mid-1990s.
about: Texas Solar Power Company (TXSPC) works from East Austin on solar design and installation, energy efficiency retrofits and energy management for homes, businesses and institutions.

name: Meridian Solar
usp: Commercial and utility-scale projects only: development, engineering, construction and financing.
about: Meridian Solar has built solar projects from Austin since 1999 for companies, government bodies, non-profits and utilities. It is not a residential installer.

name: Suncharge Solar
tierNote: The company says it passes on savings from having no sales staff; no per-watt figure is published
usp: Owner-operated with no sales team, which it says keeps prices low.
about: Suncharge Solar is a small Austin installer of solar and batteries, managed and operated locally by its owner.

name: Texas Solar Guys
usp: Helps rural customers apply for REAP grants and also repairs existing arrays.
about: Texas Solar Guys installs and repairs residential and commercial systems from Buda, serving Austin and San Antonio. It also offers reroofing.

name: DKD Energy
usp: Family-owned and operated, combining solar with roof replacement.
about: DKD Energy installs residential and commercial solar from southwest Austin and also serves San Antonio. Customers can pay upfront or with a loan.

name: Optimum Solar USA
usp: Northeast Austin installer with a large base of Google reviews.
about: Optimum Solar USA offers consultation, panel installation and help with financing for homeowners in Austin and nearby towns.
address: 1812 Centre Creek Dr, Ste 215, Austin, TX 78754

name: The American Power Company
usp: Serves homeowners, businesses and farms from southwest Austin.
about: The American Power Company installs solar and helps customers arrange financing, with a focus on making systems easy to own.

name: Austin Discount Solar
tierNote: Positions itself as a discount installer; no per-watt figure is published. Payment is upfront
usp: Discount positioning, plus removal of existing systems.
about: Austin Discount Solar designs, installs and removes residential and commercial systems from northwest Austin.

name: Greenstar Power
usp: Women-owned and veteran-operated, with 25-year workmanship and roof-penetration warranties.
about: Greenstar Power is based in Round Rock and installs residential solar, batteries and EV chargers across Texas. Panasonic named it a fastest-growing battery installer in 2021.
address: 1000 Gattis School Rd, Ste 350, Round Rock, TX 78664

name: Abundant Solar
usp: Family business focused on a 25-mile radius around San Marcos.
about: Abundant Solar installs residential solar, batteries and EV chargers south of Austin. Customers can pay upfront or with a loan.
address: 129 Old Settlers Dr, San Marcos, TX

name: Solar CenTex
usp: Founded by an Army veteran; uses no subcontractors and stresses after-sales support.
about: Solar CenTex is based in Harker Heights, about an hour north of Austin, and installs grid-tied and battery systems across Central Texas. It also repairs and decommissions systems.

name: Atma Energy
usp: EnergySage's Local Installer of the Year for Texas in 2026.
about: Atma Energy is headquartered in San Antonio and installs solar and batteries in the Austin and San Antonio areas.
address: 1430 N Flores St, Ste 200, San Antonio, TX 78212

name: Good Faith Energy
usp: Every installer is a company employee; more than 3,000 solar projects and 1,600 batteries.
about: Good Faith Energy is based in the Dallas area and serves Austin, Cedar Park, Georgetown and Leander. It also does roofing and installs Tesla, REC and SPAN equipment.

name: Circle L Solar
usp: Works only in Texas, handling sales through installation itself.
about: Circle L Solar is a Fort Worth company that lists Austin among its service cities. It offers residential and commercial solar, energy monitoring and EV charging.

name: TriSMART Solar
usp: Texas-made panels and 25-year warranties covering equipment, workmanship and roof.
about: TriSMART Solar is a Houston-based residential installer with an Austin office. It is also a roofing contractor. Reviews are mixed across platforms.

name: Tesla Energy
tierNote: Regularly described as among the lowest-priced options; pricing is shown online
usp: Low prices and an automated online design process, with little customisation.
about: Tesla sells solar panels, Solar Roof and Powerwall batteries nationwide and is headquartered in Austin. Installation is commonly handled by subcontracted crews.

name: Sunrun
tierNote: National installers are reported to cost roughly 15–25% more than local ones
usp: The largest US residential solar company, known for leases and power purchase agreements with no money down.
about: Sunrun offers solar and batteries in the Austin area, mostly through lease and PPA contracts rather than purchases.

name: Palmetto
usp: A national provider with a large volume of marketplace reviews.
about: Palmetto sells residential solar and batteries across the United States and appears among the top-ranked providers for Austin on the EnergySage marketplace.

name: Project Solar
tierNote: Full-service installation from $1.61 per watt; do-it-yourself kits from $1.26 per watt
usp: Published online pricing with no sales visits, and a do-it-yourself option.
about: Project Solar sells streamlined solar installations and DIY kits nationally, aimed at budget-conscious buyers.

name: NuWatt Energy
tierNote: About $2.60–$2.90 per watt cash, according to the company
usp: Offers cash, loan and lease or PPA options, with NABCEP-certified design.
about: NuWatt Energy installs residential solar in several states including Texas, with crews serving Austin, Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston and San Antonio.
